title: Fourier coefficient of a direct product
statement: For all natural numbers $n,m$, real-valued functions $f$ on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ and $g$ on $\mathbb{F}_2^m$, and vectors $a\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, $b\in\mathbb{F}_2^m$, the vector Fourier coefficient of their direct-product function at the concatenated vector $(a,b)$ equals the product of the coefficient of $f$ at $a$ and the coefficient of $g$ at $b$.
